item.title: Local roundup: Crush win gold; Morin re-signs; Zomerman honoured
item.description: The Chatham Kent U13 C Crush struck gold at the Durham West Bolts and Hearts tournament last weekend.

item.title: RHODES: Theatre became auctioneering room for Harrington and McCoig
item.description: Recently I told you about the remarkable Archibald Blake McCoig, an auctioneer and farm equipment dealer, who partnered with R.A. Harrington in a multi-line business. McCoig was to become the most remarkable politician ever to reside in Chatham. McCoig represented the former West Kent riding in both the federal and provincial houses and is one of only two men ever appointed to represent a riding that included […]

item.title: High school roundup: Ursuline wrestlers win at SWOSSAA; CKSS in hockey finals
item.description: The Ursuline Lancers won two individual titles and placed second in the boys team standings at the SWOSSAA wrestling championship Thursday in Windsor.

item.title: PHOTOS: Sam Roberts Band takes Capitol stage
item.description: Sam Roberts Band brought the hits to an enthusiastic crowd at the Chatham Capitol Theatre on Thursday night.

item.title: Pain Court Patriotes keep LKSSAA girls volleyball championship
item.description: The Pain Court Patriotes defended their LKSSAA senior girls A volleyball title with a three-set sweep of the Chatham Christian Flames.

item.title: Our Door is Open to Everyone campaign relaunches
item.description: CK Pride, in partnership with the Municipality of Chatham-Kent, is relaunching the Our Door is Open to Everyone campaign.

item.title: Chatham Christian holds off Pain Court in LKSSAA championship thriller
item.description: Chatham Christian defended its LKSSAA senior boys A basketball title with a 56-55 win over Pain Court on Thursday.

item.title: Wallaceburg box lunch fundraiser returns March 26
item.description: Community Living Wallaceburg’s annual box lunch fundraiser is expanding to include local schools for the first time. The event, which raises money for the agency’s accessible transportation services, will be held March 26.
